why_dynamic: Candidate must show a standing-wave mode establishing or changing over time; a single static wave pattern is insufficient.
Candidate must show temporal oscillation with nodes and antinodes rather than a still wave diagram.
Candidate must show oscillation amplitude growth or mode excitation under periodic parameter variation; not just a pendulum swing.
Candidate must show impact, deformation, capillary retraction, and liftoff sequence; a single splash frame is insufficient.
Candidate must show bubble rupture followed by upward jet formation, not merely bubbles on a surface.
Candidate must show a clear shock/compression front propagating over time, not only a static schlieren image.
Candidate must show streamer filaments forming or propagating over time without title leakage.
Candidate must show arc formation and motion/bending, not just a static spark photograph.
Candidate must show vapor-film mediated boiling dynamics over time, not just hot liquid or steam.
Candidate must show bubbles nucleating, growing, and departing from a heated surface.
